message.content: {"note_claim": "Alt News की जांच में पाया गया कि वीडियो असली है और उत्सव के कई वीडियो अलग कोणों से मेल खाते हैं।", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Several social media users posted videos of the same programme captured from different angles. Uniformed police personnel were standing on the stage as well as below the stage watching the dancers as the performance went on. Thus, the Kashi DCP's claim that the video is AI-generated does not hold up.", "reason": "The Alt News article directly concludes the video is real and not AI-generated, and documents multiple matching videos from different angles, substantiating the note's claims."}

parsed.note_claim: Alt News की जांच में पाया गया कि वीडियो असली है और उत्सव के कई वीडियो अलग कोणों से मेल खाते हैं।
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Several social media users posted videos of the same programme captured from different angles. Uniformed police personnel were standing on the stage as well as below the stage watching the dancers as the performance went on. Thus, the Kashi DCP's claim that the video is AI-generated does not hold up.
parsed.reason: The Alt News article directly concludes the video is real and not AI-generated, and documents multiple matching videos from different angles, substantiating the note's claims.
